ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $\angle AOD$ and $\angle BOC$ are both right angles, $\angle AOC = 38^\circ$, and $OE$ bisects $\angle BOD$. What is the measure of $\angle COE$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since $\angle AOD$ is a right angle and $\angle AOC=38^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle COD=\angle AOD-\angle AOC=90^\circ-38^\circ=52^\circ$.\\
Since $\angle BOC$ is also a right angle,\\
we have $\angle BOD=\angle BOC-\angle COD=90^\circ-52^\circ=38^\circ$.\\
Given that OE bisects $\angle BOD$,\\
it follows that $\angle DOE= \frac{1}{2} \angle BOD= \frac{1}{2} \times 38^\circ=19^\circ$.\\
Therefore, $\angle COE=\angle COD+\angle DOE=52^\circ+19^\circ=\boxed{71^\circ}$.
